settings.label: Manual transfer
settings.title: Bank accounts
settings.description: Accounts buyers transfer to. Each order keeps a copy of the account it was placed with, so edits only apply to new orders.
settings.empty: No bank accounts yet. Add one so buyers can pay by transfer.
settings.loadError: Could not load the bank accounts.

account.label: Internal name
account.labelHint: Only visible in the Admin, e.g. "USD pocket"
account.regionsHint: Leave all unticked to offer this account in every region with its currency.
account.rankHint: When several accounts match, the lowest number is used.
account.activeHint: Inactive accounts are not offered for new orders.

actions.underpaidText: Less than the amount due arrived. The transfer is recorded, the order shows what is left, and the buyer can upload a proof for the rest. Nothing is captured yet.
actions.bankCheck: Look for the transfer in your banking app or the account statement. Never rely on the proof image alone: proofs are easy to fake.
actions.bankReferenceHint: Optional, e.g. the transaction id in the statement
actions.shortfallText: Record it as underpaid so the buyer pays the rest, or confirm anyway if the store absorbs the difference (e.g. bank fees).
actions.acceptShortfall: Confirm as paid anyway; the store absorbs {{amount}}
actions.coversAll: This covers the whole amount due. Use "Confirm paid" instead.
actions.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. The amount on the proof is not readable
actions.reasonHint: The buyer sees this reason and can upload a new proof.

confirmDelete.title: Delete this bank account?
confirmDelete.description: {{name}} will no longer be offered. Existing orders keep their payment instructions.

widget.title: Manual transfer
widget.substitutedText: The account chosen at checkout ({{from}}) was not available when the order was placed, so the buyer was given {{to}}. Check that the transfer goes to this account.
widget.loadError: Could not load the manual transfer payment.

reason.not_offered_in_region: account not offered in this region

widget.duplicate: The same file was already uploaded for another order:
widget.nativeCapture: Medusa's own "Capture" button in the Payments section is not used for bank transfers and is refused. Confirm here once the money is in the bank statement; that captures the payment.
widget.fileDeleted: File deleted under the retention setting ({{date}})

queue.label: Manual transfers
queue.title: Manual transfers
queue.description: Payments by bank transfer. Open an order to check its proof and confirm, record an underpayment or reject.
queue.loadError: Could not load the manual transfer payments.

identity.title: Store details for e-mails and invoices
identity.description: Buyers see this name, logo and contact details in the payment e-mails and on the pro-forma invoice.
identity.name: Store name
identity.logoHint: PNG or JPG, shown in e-mails and on the invoice.
identity.emailHint: Shown to buyers; replies go to the sender address of your e-mail provider.
